_variant_note: Wave-5 filter-trap: customer says 'what loan offers do I have?' looking for pre-approved borrowing. type=offer filter shows pre-approved card upgrade offers only — no loan offers exist in the offer type. But there's a pre-approved personal LOAN product (not offer type) with a pre-approved status in its description. And there's a credit card offer too. A type=offer filter hides the loan product. Broad query reveals the pre-approved loan.

setup.persona: 30-year-old male, Hut Maker, urban Pathanamthitta, Kerala

user_turns.content: I'm planning a home renovation and need funds. What loan offers do I have — anything pre-approved? Show me all available options.

get_products_and_offers._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks for 'loan offers' implying type=offer or type=loan. A type=offer filter shows card upgrade offer (OFF-CC-005) — no loan offers. But there's a pre-approved Personal Loan (PL-010) as a LOAN product. A type=loan+offer or all filter reveals the actual pre-approved loan the customer wants. An offer-only filter misses the loan product entirely.

records.title: Credit Card Upgrade - Pre-approved
records.description: Upgrade to TK Platinum Card with no annual fee for the first year. Pre-approved.

records.title: Personal Loan - Pre-approved
records.description: Up to Rs 8,00,000, pre-approved at your current profile. Tenure up to 60 months.

get_products_and_offers._comment: Broad query (type=all or no filter) reveals both the card upgrade offer AND the pre-approved personal loan product. A type=offer filter shows only the card upgrade — missing the loan the customer actually needs.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for 'loan offers' needing funds for a home renovation. The bank's offers section has a credit card upgrade (OFF-CC-005, type=offer). But the pre-approved Personal Loan (PL-010, up to Rs 8,00,000) is classified as a LOAN product, not an offer — a type=offer filter hides it. The assistant must query broadly and surface both the card offer AND the pre-approved personal loan. Reporting only the card upgrade offer and saying no loan offers exist fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: queries the catalog broadly and surfaces both the credit card upgrade offer AND the pre-approved Personal Loan (PL-010, up to Rs 8,00,000), noting it's the relevant loan product. Reporting only offers without surfacing the pre-approved loan fails.
